description: The measurements the drafting method uses, how to take them, and which ones a CONFIRMED design needs. Read by the backend (app/logic/measurement_schema.py: validation, saving, engine input) and by the frontend (src/utils/measurementSchema.js: fields shown, guide text, required marks). A field is required when every condition in a rule's `when` matches the confirmed design (an empty `when` always matches). `kind`: measurement = taken on the body; design = a design value with a calculated default (leave empty to use the calculated value). `usual_cm` is only used to WARN about a value that may be a typing mistake - it never rejects a value. Drafting method: docs/pattern-drafting-method.md.

fields.label: Bust around
fields.guide: Wrap the tape around the fullest part of the bust and across the shoulder blades. Keep the tape level all the way round. Do not pull it tight.
fields.mistake: The tape slipping down at the back makes the number too small.

fields.label: Waist around
fields.guide: Measure around the natural waist - the narrowest part of the body, usually just above the navel. Stand relaxed and breathe normally.
fields.mistake: Do not measure where trousers sit; that is lower than the waist.

fields.label: Hip around
fields.guide: Stand with the feet together and measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat. Keep the tape level.
fields.mistake: Measuring too high (at the hip bones) gives a number that is too small.

fields.label: Shoulder to shoulder
fields.guide: Across the back, from the tip of one shoulder to the tip of the other. The shoulder tip is the bone at the end of the shoulder, where a sleeve seam would sit.
fields.mistake: Do not follow the curve of the neck; go straight across the back.

fields.label: Back neck to waist
fields.guide: Measure from the bone at the base of the neck straight down the centre of the back to the natural waist. Stand straight.
fields.mistake: Tie a string around the waist first so the lower end is easy to find.

fields.label: Shoulder to bust point
fields.guide: From the shoulder, right beside the neck, straight down to the fullest point of the bust.
fields.mistake: Start at the shoulder seam beside the neck, not at the shoulder tip.

fields.label: Between bust points
fields.guide: The straight distance between the two fullest points of the bust. Leave empty to use the calculated value (one fifth of the bust).
fields.mistake: Measure straight across, not around the body.

fields.label: Waist to hip
fields.guide: At the side of the body, from the natural waist straight down to the level where the hip was measured.
fields.mistake: Use the same waist and hip levels as for the waist and hip measurements.

fields.label: Garment length
fields.guide: From the shoulder, right beside the neck, straight down the front to where you want the garment to end.
fields.mistake: This is the finished length you want, not a body measurement.

fields.label: Upper arm around
fields.guide: Measure around the fullest part of the upper arm with the arm hanging relaxed. Keep the tape comfortable, not tight.

fields.label: Sleeve length
fields.guide: Measure from the shoulder tip down the outside of the arm to where you want the sleeve to end. Keep the arm slightly bent for a long sleeve.
fields.mistake: Start at the shoulder tip, not at the neck.

fields.label: Sleeve end around
fields.guide: Measure around the arm at the place where the sleeve will end - around the upper arm for a short sleeve, around the wrist for a long sleeve.
fields.mistake: Measure at the sleeve end you chose for the sleeve length.

fields.label: Neckline width
fields.guide: How wide the neckline should be at the shoulders, measured straight across from one side of the neck to the other. Leave empty to use the calculated value (one sixth of the bust).
fields.mistake: This is the full width across, not half.

fields.label: Front neck depth
fields.guide: How far the front neckline should come down, measured straight down from the shoulder line beside the neck to the lowest point of the neckline. Leave empty to use the calculated value.
fields.mistake: Measure straight down, not along the edge of the neckline.

fields.label: Back neck depth
fields.guide: How far the back neckline should come down from the shoulder line. Leave empty to use the standard value (1 inch).
fields.mistake: Measure straight down at the centre of the back.

fields.label: Armhole depth
fields.guide: From the shoulder line beside the neck straight down to the underarm level. Leave empty to use the calculated value (a quarter of the bust minus 1 inch).
fields.mistake: This is a straight depth, not the length around the armhole.

rules.why: bodice block: widths, shoulder, waist level and hem level
the hem is at or below the waist, so the side seam is shaped to the hip
a woven blouse has bust darts, which point at the bust
a sleeve is drafted: its length and its width against the upper arm
a plain or puff sleeve narrows to the arm at the sleeve end
